output.reason: The changelog line alone [ev-f19f9439e7c8] doesn't name the setting, but the linked PR [ev-99f4ec8d6c64] does. It says the change adds a new option named key_prefix under the aws storage stanza, which puts a constant prefix on all created object keys. It also says this differs from compactor.shared_store_key_prefix because it covers files such as loki_cluster_seed.json too. That gives the subject (config key aws.key_prefix) and the change type (added). The PR describes the option as opt-in, for running many Loki installations in one bucket, so only environments that set it are exposed. Nothing in the evidence describes a default-behaviour change for environments that don't set it. The changed files [ev-36b3760baef9] support this: a new prefixed object client plus factory changes. The full storage_config path and the default value are not spelled out, but the evidence is enough to write the subject and applicability.
